description: Returns one Strong's entry (Hebrew H… or Greek G…): lemma, transliteration, definition, KJV renderings, occurrence count and verses per book. For Hebrew it adds the Brown–Driver–Briggs entry and, for a name, how it is built from its parts; it also gives the Septuagint renderings of a Hebrew word, or the Hebrew words a Greek word renders. Use when the user asks what a Hebrew or Greek word means, given its Strong's number.

max_chars.description: optional: cap the answer at about this many characters (lists are shortened and marked truncated; use offset/nextOffset to get the rest)

name: get_word
title: Look up a word
